theorems.name: Submission.aal_pinched_constants
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (κ ω : ℝ), 0 < κ → 0 < ω → ∃ Cp δp : ℝ, 1 ≤ Cp ∧ 0 < δp ∧ δp ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ δp ≤ κ ∧ Cp * δp ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ δp → Real.exp (2 * (t / κ)) * ((1 + t) / (1 - 4 * t) ^ n * ω) + 2 * Real.exp (t / κ) * (t / κ) ≤ (1 + Cp * t) * ω ∧ (1 - Cp * t) * ω ≤ Real.exp (-(t / κ)) * (ω - t / κ) ∧ Real.exp (t / κ) * (Real.exp (t / κ) * ((1 + t) / (1 - 4 * t) ^ n * ω) + t / κ - ω) ≤ Cp * ω * t
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
